key_insight: A physics-informed heating-intensity constraint improves welding-parameter recommendations while enabling controllable strong- and weak-regime settings.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce trial-and-error parameter design for diverse automotive sheet stacks while improving physical consistency.
method: Map sheet attributes and target nugget size to welding parameters using heterogeneous ensemble learning.
Jointly minimize parameter prediction error and heating-intensity deviation.
Adjust heating intensity to generate strong- or weak-regime parameter combinations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved prediction accuracy in same-vehicle and cross-vehicle evaluations, but provides no dataset sizes or numerical metrics.
watch_item: The reported solution-space compression does not by itself establish unique, production-ready settings across unseen materials and operating conditions.
paper_title: Development and optimization of parameter recommendation model for automotive resistance spot welding
